summary.headline: Venus Combustion in Libra and Scorpio
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the combustion of Venus in Libra and Scorpio, including effects of lunar and planetary conjunctions or aspects on rulers, weather, prices, women, soldiers, religion, and regional enemies. The forecasts mention Khorasan, Arab tribes, southern winds, rain, famine, travel, and public welfare.
